messages:
tanvi: heads up — p95 on /generate jumped to ~1.2s in gpu-prod-us-west-2 around 10:08 UTC. latency traces show kernel fallback churn + a spike in kv-cache evictions for tenant telemetry-analytics :eyes:
infra-bot: metric snapshot: p95=1.22s, p99=2.6s, qps=-18% vs baseline, kv_cache_free=12%, kernel_fallback_rate=0.37 :bar_chart:
ryan: link to the latest flame/trace? want to see where time is going (kernel vs memcpy)
tanvi: flamegraph https://artifacts.internal/runs/1748321110/flame.svg — main diff is kernel_select switching between primary/alt every few requests, GPU sched shows higher occupancy, also saw tiny spikes in seq_len that caused kernel reshuffle
devin: sounds like batching heuristics + kernel selector thrashing. quick mitigation: limit max_batch to 8 for that tenant and force primary kernel for small seqs. also reduce prefix caching eviction aggressiveness temporarily
maria: can we flip a feature flag and a route rule? i don't want to redeploy runtime if possible
jules: i can run the flags and route. suggested commands:
```
/ff set inference.kernel_force_primary=true --scope tenant:telemetry-analytics
/ff set batching.max_batch=8 --scope tenant:telemetry-analytics
/routing move tenant telemetry-analytics -> pool dedicated-pool-2 --ttl 30m
```
plus set kvcache.eviction_alpha=0.3
jules: running the ff now (will canary to 5 hosts) :hammer_and_wrench:
infra-bot: featureflag change applied: inference.kernel_force_primary=true (canary 5/50 hosts)
infra-bot: routing change scheduled — moving 2/10 hosts now to dedicated-pool-2 :truck:
incident-bot: Incident INC-20260318 created by tanvi — latency spike affecting telemetry-analytics. severity=high, mitigations in progress, channel=eng-runtime
sre-oncall: will monitor p95/p99 and collector logs, please post updates. if the canary looks good, roll to 100%
ryan: if this stabilizes, follow up with kernel selector regression triage. need profiling data for selector heuristics (seq dist + perf table) to avoid recurring flaps
tanvi: confirmed p95 down to 420ms on canary hosts after flag + routing. keeping mitigations for 30m then re-evaluate. will open a perf-incident ticket with traces and perf counters. :thumbsup:
